name: One-Pan Garlic Butter Chicken & Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper
steps: Place the quartered potatoes in a microwave-safe bowl with 2 tbsp water, cover and microwave 5 minutes until just tender. Drain.
Season the chicken on both sides with paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through (165°F). Move to a plate.
Add the potatoes to the same pan and cook 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until browned and crisp at the edges.
Lower the heat to medium. Add the butter and garlic and cook 1 minute. Stir in the broth and lemon juice and simmer 2 minutes.
Return the chicken to the pan, spoon the garlic butter over everything and sprinkle with parsley.

name: 15-Minute Beef & Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak or sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain
1/2 cup beef broth mixed with 1 tsp cornstarch
steps: Toss the sliced beef with 1 tbsp cornstarch.
Steam the broccoli in the microwave with 2 tbsp water, covered, for 3 minutes. Drain.
Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Add the beef in a single layer and sear 2 minutes per side. Remove.
Lower to medium, add the garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce, brown sugar, oyster sauce and broth mixture. Simmer 1 to 2 minutes until glossy and thick.
Return the beef and broccoli, toss to coat and serve over rice.

name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water according to the package. Drain.
Season the chicken with Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and broth and bring to a simmer. Stir in the Parmesan until melted.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted, then toss in the pasta.

name: Ground Beef Taco Skillet
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes with green chiles
Toppings: sour cream, cilantro, sliced green onion, tortilla chips
steps: Brown the ground beef and onion in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat, about 7 minutes. Drain the fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning, beans, tomatoes, corn and water.
Simmer 8 minutes until thickened.
Sprinkle the cheese on top, cover and let it melt for 2 minutes (or slide under the broiler for 2 minutes).
Serve with your favorite toppings and chips for scooping.

name: Honey Garlic Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water
Sliced green onion and sesame seeds
Cooked rice and steamed vegetables, to serve
steps: Whisk the honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and cook 1 to 2 minutes per side until pink. Move to a plate.
Pour the sauce into the pan and simmer 1 minute. Stir in the cornstarch mixture and cook until thick and glossy.
Return the shrimp and toss to coat.
Top with green onion and sesame seeds and serve over rice.

name: Lemon Herb Sheet Pan Salmon & Green Beans
Creamy Tomato Tortellini Soup
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 4 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, broth and Italian seasoning. Bring to a boil.
Add the tortellini and simmer 5 to 7 minutes until tender.
Stir in the cream and spinach until wilted.
Serve topped with Parmesan.

name: Skillet Marry Me Chicken
ingredients: 4 thin-cut chicken breasts (or 2 large breasts sliced in half)
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and paprika.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through. Remove.
Lower to medium, add the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes and cook 1 minute.
Add the broth, cream, Parmesan and Italian seasoning. Simmer 3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Return the chicken, spoon the sauce over and top with basil.

name: Better-Than-Takeout Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes until cooked through. Remove.
Add the onion and peas and carrots and cook 3 minutes.
Push aside, add the remaining oil and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil and toss. Top with green onions.

name: Cajun Chicken Alfredo
steps: Cook the fettuccine in salted water. Drain.
Toss the chicken with 1 1/2 tsp Cajun seasoning and cook in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through. Remove.
Melt the butter in the pan, add the garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add the cream and remaining Cajun seasoning and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan until smooth, then toss with the pasta and chicken. Top with parsley.

name: Korean Ground Beef Bowls
ingredients: Sliced green onion and sesame seeds
steps: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Add the beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned, about 7 minutes. Drain if needed.
Stir in the soy sauce, brown sugar and red pepper flakes and simmer 2 minutes.
Serve over rice with cucumber and carrot.
Top with green onions and sesame seeds.

name: Crockpot Honey Garlic Chicken
ingredients: 2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water (cooking day)
Sesame seeds, green onion and rice, to serve
steps: Freezer prep: Whisk the honey, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic and pepper. Place the chicken in a gallon freezer bag, pour in the sauce, press out the air, seal and freeze flat.
Cooking day: Thaw overnight in the fridge.
Empty the bag into the slow cooker. Cook on LOW 4 to 5 hours (or HIGH 2 to 3 hours) until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove the chicken and shred or cut into pieces. Stir the cornstarch mixture into the sauce, cover and cook on HIGH 15 minutes until thick.
Return the chicken, toss and serve over rice with sesame seeds and green onion.

name: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lb beef chuck, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
1 1/2 lb Yukon gold potatoes, cut into chunks
steps: Freezer prep: Toss the beef with flour, salt and pepper. Add the beef, potatoes, carrots, onion, garlic, tomato paste, Worcestershire and thyme to a gallon freezer bag. Seal, label and freeze flat.
Cooking day: Thaw overnight in the fridge.
Empty the bag into the slow cooker and pour in the broth.
Cook on LOW 8 hours or HIGH 4 to 5 hours until the beef is tender.
Stir in the peas for the last 10 minutes. Season to taste.

name: Easy Slow Cooker Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder
2 sprigs fresh rosemary or 1 tsp dried
steps: Freezer prep: Rub the roast with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Place in a gallon bag with the potatoes, carrots, onion, soup mix, Worcestershire and rosemary. Seal and freeze.
Cooking day: Thaw completely in the fridge (allow 24 to 36 hours for a roast).
Empty the bag into the slow cooker and pour the broth over.
Cook on LOW 8 to 9 hours until the beef falls apart.
Slice or shred and spoon the juices over the top.

name: Creamy White Chicken Chili
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz) great northern beans, drained
Toppings: shredded Monterey Jack, cilantro, lime
steps: Freezer prep: Add the chicken, beans, chiles, corn, onion, garlic and spices to a freezer bag. Seal and freeze.
Cooking day: Thaw overnight in the fridge.
Empty into the slow cooker with the broth. Cook on LOW 6 hours.
Shred the chicken, add the cream cheese and stir until melted.
Serve with cheese, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

name: Cheesy Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb Italian sausage or ground beef
steps: Cook the pasta 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain.
Brown the meat and drain. Stir in the marinara and crushed tomatoes.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, ricotta, Parmesan and 1 1/2 cups mozzarella.
Spread in a 9x13 foil pan and top with the remaining mozzarella.
To freeze: Cover and freeze. To bake: Thaw overnight and bake covered at 375°F for 20 minutes, then uncovered 10 minutes.

name: Make-Ahead Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb frozen diced hash brown potatoes
steps: Brown the sausage in a large skillet and remove. Cook the hash browns in the same pan until golden.
Whisk the eggs and milk, season and scramble until just set.
Let everything cool for 10 minutes.
Fill each tortilla with eggs, sausage, potatoes and cheese. Roll tightly, wrap each in foil or plastic wrap and freeze in a bag.
To reheat: Unwrap, wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave 2 to 3 minutes, flipping halfway.

name: Italian Sausage & Lentil Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried brown or green lentils, rinsed
steps: Brown the sausage in a large pot. Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth and Italian seasoning.
Simmer 30 to 35 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the greens until wilted and season to taste.
Cool and freeze in portions. Serve with Parmesan.

name: One-Pot Cheesy Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Heat the oil in a large lidded pot over medium-high heat. Season the chicken with garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper and brown 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice and broth and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce to low and simmer 15 minutes.
Scatter the broccoli on top, cover and cook 5 minutes more until the rice is tender.
Stir in the cheese until melted and season to taste.

name: Chicken & Biscuit Dumplings
ingredients: 1 can (16 oz) refrigerated biscuits, each cut into quarters
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot and brown the chicken and onion 6 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then slowly add the broth and milk. Add the thyme and vegetables.
Bring to a gentle simmer and season.
Drop the biscuit pieces on top, cover and simmer 15 minutes without lifting the lid until puffed and cooked through.
Serve in bowls.

name: Buffalo Chicken Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta and drain.
Cook the chicken in the oil over medium-high heat 7 minutes until cooked through.
Lower the heat and add the cream cheese, hot sauce, milk and garlic powder. Stir until smooth.
Stir in the cheese until melted.
Toss with the pasta and top with green onion.

name: Homemade Cheeseburger Pasta
steps: Brown the beef and onion in a large pot and drain.
Stir in the garlic powder, paprika and tomato paste.
Add the broth, milk and uncooked pasta. Bring to a boil, then simmer, stirring often, 10 to 12 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Hamburger Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of mushroom soup
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13 dish.
Brown the beef and onion and drain. Season with half the salt and pepper.
Whisk the soup, milk and garlic powder.
Layer half the potatoes, half the beef, half the sauce and half the cheese. Repeat.
Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more until the potatoes are tender.

name: Old-Fashioned American Goulash
steps: Brown the beef and onion in a large pot and drain. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, water, Worcestershire and seasonings.
Bring to a boil and stir in the macaroni.
Simmer, covered, 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the cheese and season to taste.

name: Smothered Pork Chops & Rice
ingredients: 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, salt and pepper
steps: Season the chops with paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Brown in the oil in a large skillet 3 to 4 minutes per side. Remove.
Add the butter and onion and cook 5 minutes. Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Whisk in the broth and milk and simmer until thick.
Return the chops, cover and simmer 10 minutes until they reach 145°F. Serve over rice with the gravy.

name: Crispy Black Bean Quesadillas
ingredients: Butter or oil for the pan
steps: Mash half the beans and mix with the whole beans, corn, spices and salsa.
Spread the filling over half of each tortilla, top with cheese and fold.
Cook in a lightly buttered skillet over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.
Cut into wedges.
Serve with sour cream and more salsa.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook the onion and vegetables 3 minutes.
Push aside, add the remaining oil and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes until hot.
Add the soy sauce and sesame oil and toss.
Top with green onions.

name: Cheesy Broccoli Potato Soup
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onion 5 minutes. Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth, then add the potatoes. Simmer 12 minutes.
Add the broccoli and simmer 6 minutes until everything is tender.
Mash some of the potatoes for a thicker soup, then stir in the milk.
Off the heat, stir in the cheese until melted. Season to taste.

name: Potato, Pepper & Egg Breakfast Hash
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked sausage or bacon, diced (optional)
steps: Microwave the potatoes with 2 tbsp water, covered, for 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large skillet and cook the potatoes 8 minutes until golden.
Add the onion, pepper, sausage and paprika and cook 6 minutes.
Make 6 wells, crack an egg into each, cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with cheese and serve.

name: Greek Yogurt Lemon Herb Chicken Bowls
ingredients: Tzatziki: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 grated cucumber, 1 clove garlic, dill, lemon juice
steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, zest, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Coat the chicken and marinate at least 10 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat 6 to 7 minutes per side until 165°F. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Stir together the tzatziki ingredients.
Divide the quinoa between bowls and top with chicken, cucumber, tomatoes and red onion.
Spoon tzatziki over the top.

name: Turkey Taco Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: Toppings: plain Greek yogurt, avocado, cilantro, lime
steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and pepper 4 minutes.
Add the turkey and spices and cook, breaking it up, 7 to 8 minutes until browned.
Stir in the salsa and beans and simmer 3 minutes.
Spoon into lettuce cups.
Top with Greek yogurt, avocado, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

name: High-Protein Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: 8 oz high-protein or whole wheat fettuccine
steps: Cook the pasta and drain.
Season the chicken and cook in the oil 6 to 7 minutes until cooked through.
Blend the cottage cheese, milk and Parmesan until completely smooth.
Add the garlic to the pan for 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and warm gently (don't boil). Season.
Toss in the pasta and broccoli and top with parsley.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowls with Cottage Cheese Queso
ingredients: Queso: 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese, 1/2 cup shredded cheddar, 2 tbsp milk, 1/2 tsp chili powder
steps: Toss the chicken with taco seasoning and cook in the oil 7 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Blend the cottage cheese, cheddar, milk and chili powder until smooth. Warm in the microwave 1 minute, stirring halfway.
Build bowls with rice, beans, corn, lettuce and chicken.
Top with pico de gallo.
Drizzle with the cottage cheese queso.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 large bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded
1 1/4 lb lean ground beef or turkey
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the meat and onion and drain. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes, Italian seasoning and salt.
Stuff the peppers, stand them in a baking dish with 1/4 cup water, cover with foil and bake 25 minutes.
Uncover, top with mozzarella and bake 10 minutes more.

name: Honey Garlic Salmon & Green Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan.
Toss the green beans with oil and spread on the pan. Place the salmon in the center.
Whisk the honey, soy sauce, garlic and lemon juice and brush over the salmon.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

name: Cottage Cheese Lasagna Bake
ingredients: 10 oz whole wheat or high-protein rotini
1 lb lean ground beef or turkey
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the pasta 2 minutes less than the package says and drain.
Brown the meat and stir in the marinara.
Mix the cottage cheese, egg, Parmesan and Italian seasoning.
Toss the pasta with the meat sauce. Layer half in a 9x13 dish, spread the cottage cheese mixture over, then top with the remaining pasta and the mozzarella.
Bake 25 minutes until bubbly. Top with basil.
